author: Matt Wolfe
description:
I think this might be the coolest thing Anthropic released this week.

With the new Figma MCP server, you can pull your localhost directly into Figma, redesign it with your team, and then use a link to that frame to update your actual codebase.

It’s called "Roundtripping," and it basically solves the handoff problem between engineering and design.

Who’s trying this out?

For all the latest AI model updates and news, check out my full video on YouTube (linked in bio).
